title: Choosing and changing the option
objectives: Say what to do for a new investment, an income need, and an IDCW-reinvestment client.
Explain the costs of switching from IDCW to growth.
body_md:
New investment: default to growth; choose IDCW only after explaining the tax and NAV drop, and record why. Client wants regular income: set up an SWP from the growth option instead, unless the client prefers IDCW after a clear explanation. Client is in IDCW reinvestment: explain that growth gives the same result without yearly tax; discuss switching. Switching from IDCW to growth is treated as a redemption and fresh purchase: check capital gains tax, exit load and any ELSS lock-in first. Future payouts only: some AMCs let investors change the option for future investments without switching existing units; check the AMC's process.

| Situation | What to do |
| --- | --- |
| New investment | Default to growth; choose IDCW only after explaining the tax and NAV drop, and record why |
| Client wants regular income | Set up an SWP from the growth option instead, unless the client prefers IDCW after a clear explanation |
| Client is in IDCW reinvestment | Explain that growth gives the same result without yearly tax; discuss switching |
| Switching from IDCW to growth | Treated as a redemption and fresh purchase: check capital gains tax, exit load and any ELSS lock-in first |
| Future payouts only | Some AMCs let investors change the option for future investments without switching existing units; check the AMC's process |
example: Switching IDCW → growth: check capital gains tax, exit load and ELSS lock-in first — it counts as a redemption and a fresh purchase.
